# 佛說阿闍世王經

**ID:** T0626
**Volume:** T15
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 後漢 支婁迦讖譯
**Dynasty:** 東漢
**Date:** 147–186
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0626

## Contributors
- 支婁迦讖 (A000163)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T626 (two fascicles; Sanskrit *Ajātaśatrukaukṛtyavinodana-sūtra*, "Sūtra on the Removal of King Ajātaśatru's Remorse") is the earliest of four Chinese versions of the *Ajātaśatru-paripṛcchā* — a major Mahāyāna *sūtra* concerned with the bodhisattva [文殊](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%AE%8A) (Mañjuśrī)'s instruction of King Ajātaśatru of Magadha, whose remorse for the murder of his father is healed through the realization that all *dharma*s are devoid of intrinsic nature. The other Chinese versions are [T627](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0264) (Dharmarakṣa, *Wénshūzhīlì pǔchāo sānmèi jīng*), [T628](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0265) ([Fǎtiān](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E5%A4%A9), *Wèicéngyǒu zhèngfǎ jīng*), and [T629](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0266) (anonymous Han, *Fàngbō jīng*).

**Abstract**

T626 belongs to Lokakṣema's reliably-attested early-Mahāyāna corpus, and is one of the foundational documents of the Chinese reception of [Mañjuśrī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E6%AE%8A) as the bodhisattva of *prajñā*. Jan Nattier (2008) confirms the attribution on philological grounds. Date bracket follows Lokakṣema's translation period at Luòyáng under emperors Huán and Líng of Later Han (168–189). The text develops at length the theme that Ajātaśatru's killing of his father, [Bimbisāra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A0%BB%E5%A9%86%E5%A8%91%E7%BE%85%E7%8E%8B), cannot in absolute reality be a transgression because no agent, act or object inherently exists; the radical *prajñāpāramitā* analysis is here narrativized through royal repentance and forgiveness, an arrangement that would prove highly influential in Chinese Buddhist hagiography. T626 is the underlying source for the Ajātaśatru episode in *[the Mahāprajñāpāramitā-śāstra](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0005)* (T1509, *Dà zhìdù lùn*) and for the kingship-and-Buddhism literature of the Six Dynasties.
